question: Find literature evidence describing strategies for improving the performance of SnO2-based n-i-p perovskite solar cells. Give the strategy, mechanism, and supporting citation.
final_answer: Based on the literature (e.g., DOI: 10.1002/aenm.201803587), a key strategy for improving the performance of SnO2-based n-i-p planar perovskite solar cells involves using chloride additives (such as FACl during the antisolvent crystallization method) along with subsequent surface passivation (such as using 1-adamantylamine hydrochloride, ADAHCl). The mechanism is that these modifications improve perovskite film quality, enhance crystal growth/morphology, and retard surface/interface recombination (as demonstrated by photoluminescence and electrochemical impedance spectroscopy), leading to high open-circuit voltage, low hysteresis, and improved long-term stability and power conversion efficiency.
